pedagogical_goals: separate physical trajectory from the x-t graph
make velocity and acceleration directions visible at representative states
read x, v and a simultaneously at one instant
connect phase angle to projection and use velocity sign to distinguish states with the same displacement
select the actual positive phase arc in shortest-time problems
separate spring natural length, equilibrium and instantaneous position
distinguish elastic force from restoring force
recognize series/parallel/cut spring configurations before applying formulas
connect pendulum geometry and force components to the equilibrium direction
visualize energy conversion and the 2f energy frequency
use phasors as amplitude/phase representations rather than physical position vectors
separate amplitude decay from oscillation frequency
